intro: Step into the most inspiring moments of the Bible in a unique puzzle experience created for those who cherish the teachings of Jesus.
description:
In Parables of Jesus, each puzzle begins with a hidden image. By carefully pushing and arranging its pieces, you gradually reveal the complete scene—and with every puzzle you uncover a new passage, story, or moment from the life and teachings of Jesus.

As the image comes together, so does the story.

From His timeless parables to unforgettable moments recorded in Scripture, every completed puzzle offers a new opportunity to reflect, discover and experience the message of the Gospel in a peaceful and engaging way.

A beautiful journey through Scripture, one piece at a time. 

Featuring multiple difficulty levels.

Perfect for Christian families, Bible lovers, and anyone who wants to combine relaxing puzzle gameplay with the timeless stories of Jesus.
